entry.title: Building your first sensor dashboard
entry.content:
This tutorial shows how to collect sensor readings, push them to a simple backend, and render a dashboard with charts.

Steps include:

  1. Wiring sensors
  2. Reading values
  3. Posting to a server
entry.summary: Learn to collect readings, visualize trends, and present data clearly.

entry.title: Getting started with embedded C
entry.content:
This guide walks you through setting up a simple embedded C toolchain, flashing your first program, and reading a GPIO pin.

Prerequisites

  • A supported development board
  • Toolchain (gcc-arm-none-eabi or equivalent)
